title: Gloomhaven: Jaws of the Lion
subtitle: A cooperative campaign of tactical combat in the city of Gloomhaven
tagline: Face the rising darkness in the streets
loreSummary: You are a member of the Jaws of the Lion, an infamous mercenary group in the city of Gloomhaven. Something sinister is happening in the streets, and it is up to you to uncover the truth and put a stop to it.
keyFeatures: Accessible tutorial campaign to learn the rules gradually
Card-driven tactical combat with no dice
Play directly in the scenario book
Engaging storyline uncovering a city-wide conspiracy

jotl_standard.description: The main storyline of the Jaws of the Lion.

jotl_completionist.description: The main story plus all side and unlockable scenarios.
